name: Mechanical seals, magnetic bearings and integrated motor-compressors
aliases: Mechanical seals, magnetic bearings and integrated motor-compressors
applications: pumps and compressors in process plants
principle: Seals keep process gas inside a machine; dry gas seals and labyrinth seals suit compressors, and spring-energised seals handle extreme temperature and pressure. Magnetic bearings and integrated motor-compressors remove oil systems and shaft seals.

process_steps.name: Fit end-face or dry gas seals at the shaft
Support the rotor on magnetic or conventional bearings
Optionally integrate motor and compressor in one sealed casing

limitations: The Wikipedia page does not cover magnetic bearings or integrated motor-compressors and gives no leakage or pressure limits
The suppliers named are general seal makers cited in the page, not confirmed for compressor service
